name: Laminates
tagline: The finish that touches every shutter, counter and panel
description: High-pressure laminate is the most specified surface in Indian interiors — it decides how a kitchen reads, how a wardrobe wears and how much a job costs per square foot. The library organises it the way designers actually shop: Brand → Collection → Design code → Colour → Texture → Finish → Thickness → Sheet size.

materials.name: Decorative laminate (HPL)
materials.blurb: Standard 1 mm high-pressure laminate — the industry default
materials.description: Kraft paper layers cured under heat and pressure with a decorative face. The 1 mm sheet is the baseline finish for wardrobes, kitchens and panelling, available in thousands of designs across every major brand.

materials.name: Solid colour laminate
materials.blurb: Flat, even colour with no pattern — the base of every modern palette
materials.description: Single-tone sheets in whites, greys, greiges and accent colours. The safest way to hold a scheme together across kitchen shutters, wardrobe fronts and loose furniture from different suppliers.

materials.name: Wood-finish laminate
materials.blurb: Printed timber grain, from pale oak to dark walnut
materials.description: The most-sold decor family in India: real timber photography printed and embossed in register so the texture follows the grain. Gives the warmth of veneer at a fraction of the cost and with none of the polishing.

materials.name: Stone & marble finish laminate
materials.blurb: Marble and stone reproductions for counters and cladding
materials.description: Book-matched marble and stone decors that read convincingly at arm's length. Used where a real slab is out of budget or out of weight limits — vanity fronts, feature walls and lift lobbies.

materials.name: Fabric-finish laminate
materials.blurb: Woven and linen textures for soft, tactile surfaces
materials.description: Textile decors with a matching embossed texture, giving panelling the softness of upholstery without the maintenance. Popular on bedbacks, wardrobe shutters and hospitality panelling.

materials.name: Metal-finish laminate
materials.blurb: Brushed brass, copper and steel looks without the metal
materials.description: Metallic decors — brushed gold, antique copper, gunmetal — printed on standard HPL. All the drama of a metal panel at a tenth of the weight and cost, though they show fingerprints unless specified anti-smudge.

materials.name: High-gloss laminate
materials.blurb: Mirror-level shine for kitchens and hall units
materials.description: A high-gloss overlay that reflects light and visually opens small rooms. Beautiful when new and unforgiving thereafter — every swirl mark shows, so pair it with anti-scratch grades and handle-less profiles.

materials.name: Matte laminate
materials.blurb: Low-sheen finish that hides marks and reads contemporary
materials.description: The current default in premium residential work: a 5–15 gloss unit surface that softens light, hides dust and photographs well. Best paired with anti-fingerprint technology in dark shades.

materials.name: Suede-finish laminate
materials.description: A fine micro-texture that feels like suede under the hand and kills reflection almost entirely. Specify for bedrooms and studies where a hard shine would feel wrong.

materials.name: Textured laminate
materials.blurb: Deep 3D surface texture you can feel — wood pore, slate, ribbed
materials.description: Heavy embossing that reproduces sawn timber, riven slate or fine ribs. Adds shadow and depth to large flat runs and disguises the flatness that gives cheap joinery away.

materials.name: Anti-fingerprint laminate
materials.blurb: Dark matte surfaces that stay clean-looking in daily use
materials.description: A surface treatment that stops skin oils leaving visible marks — essential on charcoal, navy and black matte shutters, which otherwise look smeared within a week of handover.

materials.name: Scratch-resistant laminate
materials.blurb: Hardened overlay for counters and high-traffic surfaces
materials.description: An extra-hard overlay resists the abrasion that ruins ordinary laminate on worktops, study desks and reception counters. Look for the brand's abrasion class rather than a marketing claim.

materials.name: Fire-retardant laminate
materials.blurb: Class-rated surface for commercial and public interiors
materials.description: Meets flame-spread requirements for offices, hotels and hospitals where fire consultants sign off the interior finishes. Same decors as the standard range, with a certified core.

materials.name: Exterior laminate
materials.blurb: UV-stable compact sheet for façades and balconies
materials.description: Weatherproof compact laminate engineered for direct sun and rain, with a warranted colour-fastness period. Used for façade cladding, balcony panels and external signage.

materials.name: Compact laminate
materials.blurb: Self-supporting solid sheet — no substrate needed
materials.description: Full-thickness HPL that needs no board behind it, with a black or coloured core at the edges. The standard for toilet cubicles, lab counters, lockers and wet-area partitions.

materials.name: Digital laminate
materials.blurb: Your artwork printed to sheet — murals, logos, custom decors
materials.description: Digitally printed HPL lets a client's artwork, a brand logo or a bespoke pattern become a durable surface. Minimum order quantities apply, so plan it into the drawing set early.

materials.name: Acrylic laminate
materials.blurb: Mirror-gloss acrylic face with depth no HPL can match
materials.description: A cast acrylic layer over a board substrate gives a deep, glassy reflection used on premium kitchens and wardrobes. Costs several times a gloss laminate and needs careful edge banding to look right.

materials.name: Edge band
materials.blurb: PVC or ABS banding that finishes and protects every cut edge
materials.description: The detail that separates good joinery from bad: matched banding sealed to the board edge stops moisture ingress and chipping. Specify 0.8 mm for visible edges and 2 mm on shutters that take daily knocks.
